_comment: VENDORS.md declares lib/widget.min.js from a PINNED, trusted source - so unlike the vendored-library fixture it reaches the fetch, and the offline harness makes that fetch fail (outcome 'unfetchable'). A declaration alone does not exempt a file: applyUnverifiedVendor moves it into the untrusted family, and because the file is minified nothing can review it, so untrusted-minified-library rejects it and asks for source. What this pins: an unfetchable declaration must not buy an exemption.
